body:
# Better Loom
![Decorate banners](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/066565fe5b564d712bc41b342572c5f5722035d1.jpeg)

> Are you bored with standard banners that only allow you to use six patterns?
> Better Loom helps solve this problem by offering a native interface that you can customize with a resource folder template.
> 
![Custom loom interface To display it, you need to install a resource pack or adapt the template resource pack to the server resource pack.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/848951c857ba1d59711503f843fcd2a62f6cf9f0.png)

Custom loom interface
To display it, you need to install a resource pack or adapt the template resource pack to the server resource pack.

> In the config, you can set the maximum number of patterns on banners using the _**max-patterns**_ property.
> The _**gui-title**_ property is responsible for rendering the custom menu. It specifies the symbol that will be replaced with the custom interface. The &f prefix is ​​required to prevent the interface from changing color. Auxiliary symbols can also be used for deletion.
